differences.title: 1. Architecture
differences.leftDesc: Signoz uses a scalable, distributed architecture for traces, metrics, and logs, often leveraging ClickHouse for efficient data storage and querying.
differences.rightDesc: Datadog is a tightly integrated, proprietary SaaS platform with specialized ingest pipelines and storage for metrics, traces, logs, and APM.

differences.title: 2. Data Storage
differences.leftDesc: Signoz commonly uses ClickHouse, optimized for analytical queries on time-series data, offering high compression and fast read performance.
differences.rightDesc: Datadog employs its own highly optimized, proprietary storage solutions designed for massive ingest and low-latency querying of telemetry data.

differences.title: 3. Pricing Model
differences.leftDesc: Signoz is free and open-source; costs are primarily for self-hosting infrastructure, offering full control and no vendor lock-in.
differences.rightDesc: Datadog charges based on data volume, hosts, and features used, which can become expensive at scale but offers convenience.

differences.title: 4. Vendor Lock-in
differences.leftDesc: As an open-source project, Signoz allows easy migration of data and components. You control your infrastructure and data.
differences.rightDesc: Datadog's proprietary nature and integrated services create a strong vendor lock-in, making migration complex and costly.

differences.title: 5. Extensibility
differences.leftDesc: Signoz can be extended by modifying its open-source code, integrating custom collectors, or building new features directly.
differences.rightDesc: Datadog focuses on a vast ecosystem of pre-built integrations and an API for custom monitoring, rather than deep code modification.

differences.title: 6. Tracing Support
differences.leftDesc: Signoz is built with OpenTelemetry standards at its core, ingesting and processing OTel data natively for traces, metrics, and logs.
differences.rightDesc: Datadog uses its own APM agents and libraries, though it also supports OpenTelemetry ingestion, often requiring transformation.

differences.title: 7. Community & Support
differences.leftDesc: Signoz thrives on its open-source community for support, contributions, and feature development, with Slack and GitHub channels.
differences.rightDesc: Datadog offers dedicated enterprise-level support, SLAs, and professional services alongside extensive documentation.
